title: Ami, Father of Shmuel bar Ami
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He is mentioned in Pesachim 16b, and in Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 10:6 he speaks in Rav Yehudah’s name. Hyman proposes the same reading in Bava Kamma 9:2, where it is printed in error “Abaye of Shmuel bar Ami”; it should read “Ami, father of Shmuel, said in the name of Rav Yehudah.”

notes.text: The Guggenheimer digital Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 10:6 fully writes Rav Yehudah, supporting that expansion of Hyman’s abbreviated ר׳. Bava Kamma 9:2 has “father of Shmuel bar Ami” reporting Rav Yehudah, without the personal name Ami in that clause; Yevamot has Imi, father of Shmuel bar Imi. The readings are not conflated into an identical full text.
